text:
michelle (sales): Kicking off Olympus pilot. Bank wants streaming + tool/function calls + structured output. Also SSO (Okta), customer KMS, EU data residency. Need a short list of blockers and an ask for pricing/commit options. Meeting tomorrow 10am PST.

juan (se): Quick clarifying Q — they want SSE streaming to our endpoint, toolcall JSON schema for downstream systems, and example structured output for transactions. Do we have a runnable sample we can hand them?

arjun (eng-runtime): We have a minimal flow. For SSE use the /v1/streams endpoint, keep-alive, chunked transfer. Example:```curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' -d '{"model":"redwood-2","stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams``` Fallback behavior: we route to a quantized variant when host capacity is constrained (model_fallback mapping). Will add docs.

sarah (devex): I'll prep a tiny runnable Node example that shows SSE -> parse events -> call tool/adapter. For toolcalls recommend func-json with explicit output schema, e.g.```{ "name": "get_balance", "input_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"acct_id":{"type":"string"}}}, "response_schema": {"type":"object","properties":{"balance":{"type":"number"}}}}``` That keeps structured output predictable for their downstream.

james (security): On KMS — hosted offers envelope encryption + KMS integration; for Private we support customer-managed KMS/HSM. SAML/Okta SSO is supported for enterprise seats. I need their security questionnaire (SOC items + data residency). Can someone DM the questionnaire PDF?

michelle (sales): Sent questionnaire (v1) earlier today. Pricing question: they want committed capacity numbers to hit a 99th pct latency SLO of ~200ms for interactive streaming at ~50 QPS. Any ballpark reserved GPU tier suggestion and run-rate?

arjun (eng-runtime): Ballpark: for steady 50 QPS with ~1k token average per request, reserved pool ~8x A100-class or equivalent multi-TPU config. I'll run a cost calc with batching and KV cache assumed — batching helps a lot for throughput. Will post numbers in a spreadsheet.

juan (se): During their internal smoke test they observed intermittent backpressure and dropped events when bursty. Need a runbook: handshake, ack/nack policy, recommended retry windows, and recommended client-side concurrency/buffering.

sarah (devex): Ops guidance: tag each request with `X-Req-Id`, handle `503` + `Retry-After` with exponential backoff, drop after configurable ttl (e.g., 30s). For SSE libs, small wrapper around EventSource to rehydrate partial JSON works well. I'll attach code.

opsbot (deploy-bot): Canary deploy for pilot config `pilot/olympus` completed — ci/3345 :white_check_mark:

james (security): Also: they require EU-only logs + audit retention. Recommend Private VPC with region pinning or Dedicated reserved capacity in eu-west. Note: that'll change pricing and onboarding timeline.

michelle (sales): Can we get a one-pager (SSO steps, KMS options, sample code links, pricing estimate, and a short runbook for streaming/backpressure) by EOD? Customer sync tomorrow morning.

arjun (eng-runtime): I'll assemble PRD + cost calc and tag this thread. @sarah will attach Node + Python samples and @juan will own the SSO certificate exchange steps.

sarah (devex): Uploaded sample repo (internal): https://git.internal/redwood/presales/olympus-poc — includes SSE example, toolcall adapter, and structured output schema.

juan (se): Opening ticket for SSO cert exchange: #SUP-7821. I'll share contact + cert endpoint.

michelle (sales): Awesome — thanks everyone. If we can land the one-pager + cost spreadsheet tonight I can close the loop with procurement. :thumbsup:

arjun (eng-runtime): Will do. Adding quick notes in the doc about quantization tradeoffs (latency vs cost) and recommended cache policies.

sarah (devex): Also adding a sample `handshake.md` with ack/nack examples and a tiny runbook for retries.

james (security): I'll review the questionnaire answers once the doc is up and flag any compliance items.

michelle (sales): Closing plan: deliverables = 1) one-pager + cost spreadsheet, 2) sample code repo link, 3) SSO cert next steps ticket, 4) security questionnaire answers. Target: EOD today.

juan (se): Adding contact: olivia@olympusbank.com for cert exchange and a technical POC.

arjun (eng-runtime): Noted.

michelle (sales): thanks all — moving to prep slides for tomorrow.
